title: Smoke-Test Performance Across Routing Variants
caption: Average and final accuracy for CaRE and all evaluated basis-memory variants under the CIFAR-100 50+50 smoke protocol. Results are single-seed, one-epoch-per-phase observations; no error bars or statistical significance are implied.
data_source: conditions.care, conditions.signed_top2_basis_rank16, conditions.hard_top2_basis_rank16, conditions.dense_softmax_basis_rank4_equal_active_flops, conditions.hard_top2_scale01, conditions.signed_top2_scale01; metrics average_accuracy and final_top1

title: Effect of Adapter Residual Scale
caption: Changing the Hard Top-2 adapter scale to 0.1 raises average accuracy from 86.165% to 90.055% and final accuracy from 83.91% to 88.89%, while reducing forgetting from 3.78 to 3.22 points. This is a descriptive single-run ablation and does not isolate scale from run-to-run randomness.
data_source: conditions.hard_top2_basis_rank16 and conditions.hard_top2_scale01; metrics task0_top1, final_top1, average_accuracy, and forgetting

title: Load-Balancing Accuracy–Forgetting Trade-off
caption: Comparison of Hard Top-2 at scale 0.1 with load-balancing weights 0, 0.1, and 1.0. Stronger balancing lowers average and final accuracy; the low forgetting value at weight 0.1 must be interpreted alongside its lower first-phase accuracy rather than as independent evidence of improved retention.
data_source: conditions.hard_top2_scale01, conditions.hard_top2_scale01_balance01, and conditions.hard_top2_scale01_balance1; metrics task0_top1, final_top1, average_accuracy, and forgetting

title: Equal Analytical FLOPs, Unequal Measured Latency
caption: Per-layer microbenchmark latency for sparse rank-16 Signed Top-2 and dense rank-4 softmax at the same reported analytical active FLOPs of 619,773,952 per layer. Sparse routing measures 0.753 ms versus 0.533 ms for dense composition; stored parameter counts are not matched.
